items.claim: The front seam (a fresh song-frame onset at 5:1) and rear seam (a fresh hoy onset at 5:8) both carry tier-1 addressee/genre-shift warrant, and the judgment_oracle categorization for the forensically-read vineyard song matches the operative default for judgment speech outside the woe/massa frames.
items.evidence: Re-derived from the bytes: “אָשִׁ֤ירָה נָּא֙ לִֽידִידִ֔י שִׁירַ֥ת דּוֹדִ֖י לְכַרְמ֑וֹ כֶּ֛רֶם הָיָ֥ה לִֽידִידִ֖י בְּקֶ֥רֶן בֶּן שָֽׁמֶן” (oshb:Isa.5.1, byte tier) opens a first-person cohortative song frame absent from the preceding promise material, and “ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֨יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת שָׂדֶ֥ה בְשָׂדֶ֖ה יַקְרִ֑יבוּ עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְהֽוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְבַדְּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ” (oshb:Isa.5.8, byte tier) opens a fresh addressee class (land monopolists) under the chapter's first verse-initial hoy, cleanly closing the row's rear edge. No byte-true device (hoy onset, koh-amar frame, massa header, or refrain) straddles either seam undisclosed.

items.claim: The row is cleanly bracketed by adjacent hoy onsets (5:8 front, 5:11 rear) and correctly keeps the indictment and its one uninterrupted divine-speech consequence clause together rather than splitting at the consequence.
items.evidence: “ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֨יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת שָׂדֶ֥ה בְשָׂדֶ֖ה יַקְרִ֑יבוּ עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְהֽוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְבַדְּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ” (oshb:Isa.5.8, byte tier) runs as one continuous speech unit into the desolation sentence at 5:9-10 with no intervening addressee shift, frame onset, or refrain, before “ה֛וֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵ֥י בַבֹּ֖קֶר שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם” (oshb:Isa.5.11, byte tier) opens the next unit under a fresh hoy. The parashah marks disclosed (setumah at 5:7, petuchah at 5:10) are correctly framed as tier-3 corroboration, not causation.

items.claim: The seven-verse span is properly bracketed by the second and third hoy onsets (5:11, 5:18), and the row correctly keeps the bare ha-El ha-qadosh epithet at 5:16 distinct from the qadosh-Israel construct-title census rather than conflating the two objects.
items.evidence: “וַיִּגְבַּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהָאֵל֙ הַקָּד֔וֹשׁ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה” (oshb:Isa.5.16, byte tier, bare ha-El ha-qadosh epithet) is byte-distinct from the construct qedosh-Yisrael form this cluster's title sites use. No tier-1 marker (hoy onset, koh-amar frame, addressee shift) intervenes between “ה֛וֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵ֥י בַבֹּ֖קֶר שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם” (oshb:Isa.5.11) and “ה֛וֹי מֹשְׁכֵ֥י הֶֽעָוֺ֖ן בְּחַבְלֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑וְא וְכַעֲב֥וֹת הָעֲגָלָ֖ה חַטָּאָֽה” (oshb:Isa.5.18, byte tier) to warrant a sub-unit cut at the 5:15-17 reversal couplet, so keeping the reversal with its indictment is correctly argued.

items.claim: The row's claim that 5:19 is the qadosh-Israel title's 'first appearance' in the book is false, and its accompanying sweep digit (24 verses) undercounts the book's construct-title census by one.
items.evidence: “ה֣וֹי גּ֣וֹי חֹטֵ֗א עַ֚ם כֶּ֣בֶד עָוֺ֔ן זֶ֣רַע מְרֵעִ֔ים בָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֑ים עָזְב֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה נִֽאֲצ֛וּ אֶת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נָזֹ֥רוּ אָחֽוֹר” (oshb:Isa.1.4, byte tier) -- '...they have despised the Holy One of Israel...' -- carries the identical construct title form the row itself quotes at 5:19 (“הָאֹמְרִ֗ים יְמַהֵ֧ר יָחִ֛ישָׁה מַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ לְמַ֣עַן נִרְאֶ֑ה וְתִקְרַ֣ב וְתָב֗וֹאָה עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנֵדָֽעָה”), and this verse stands earlier in the book. An independent count of the construct title across the book totals 25 verses (12 in chs 1-39, 13 in chs 40-66), not the 24 the row cites; 1:4 is the omitted earlier site. The row's seam warrant (fresh hoy onset front and rear, self-contained taunt-and-title unit) is unaffected -- only the ordinal ('first appearance') and count claims are in error.

items.claim: The single-verse row is correctly bracketed by its own hoy onset and the following hoy onset at 5:21, and its rejected alternative fairly engages the real rival of merging the whole sixfold series rather than a strawman.
items.evidence: “ה֣וֹי הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לָרַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְלַטּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע שָׂמִ֨ים חֹ֤שֶׁךְ לְאוֹר֙ וְא֣וֹר לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ שָׂמִ֥ים מַ֛ר לְמָת֖וֹק וּמָת֥וֹק לְמָֽר” (oshb:Isa.5.20, byte tier) is a self-contained bicolon indictment with no internal frame break, and “ה֖וֹי חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְנֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם נְבֹנִֽים” (oshb:Isa.5.21, byte tier) opens a fresh, unrelated vice class immediately after. Atomizing at each of the ch-5 series' six verse-initial hoy onsets is the tier-1-sanctioned granularity (the oracle-unit level), not sub-unit fragmentation below any one woe's own content.

items.claim: The single-verse row is correctly bracketed by its own hoy onset and the following (sixth and final) hoy onset at 5:22, with no internal content left unaccounted for.
items.evidence: “ה֖וֹי חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְנֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם נְבֹנִֽים” (oshb:Isa.5.21, byte tier) is self-contained, and “ה֕וֹי גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים לִשְׁתּ֣וֹת יָ֑יִן וְאַנְשֵׁי חַ֖יִל לִמְסֹ֥ךְ שֵׁכָֽר” (oshb:Isa.5.22, byte tier) opens a distinct vice (mighty drinkers, bribe-taking judges) immediately after. The row correctly declines to treat 5:21 as a hinge line introducing the following unit, since 5:21 carries its own verse-initial onset.

items.claim: The device_notes' sweep digit for the qadosh-Israel title census (24 verses book-wide) undercounts the byte-swept total by one; the byte tier of both cited title sites (5:19, 5:24) is otherwise sound.
items.evidence: An independent count of the construct title across the book totals 25 verses (12 in chs 1-39, 13 in chs 40-66); “ה֣וֹי גּ֣וֹי חֹטֵ֗א עַ֚ם כֶּ֣בֶד עָוֺ֔ן זֶ֣רַע מְרֵעִ֔ים בָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֑ים עָזְב֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה נִֽאֲצ֛וּ אֶת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נָזֹ֥רוּ אָחֽוֹר” (oshb:Isa.1.4, byte tier) carries the same construct form quoted at “לָכֵן֩ כֶּאֱכֹ֨ל קַ֜שׁ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֵ֗שׁ וַחֲשַׁ֤שׁ לֶֽהָבָה֙ יִרְפֶּ֔ה שָׁרְשָׁם֙ כַּמָּ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וּפִרְחָ֖ם כָּאָבָ֣ק יַעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֣י מָאֲס֗וּ אֵ֚ת תּוֹרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֵ֛ת אִמְרַ֥ת קְדֽוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִאֵֽצוּ” (oshb:Isa.5.24) and is the omitted earlier site. The row's refrain-bridge rival disclosure (the five-site stretched-hand chain reaching oshb:Isa.9.11 = web:Isa.9.12, oshb:Isa.9.16 = web:Isa.9.17, oshb:Isa.9.20 = web:Isa.9.21, properly dual-cited in zone A) and its medium confidence for this classic crux are otherwise well-grounded and unaffected.

items.claim: The row's medium_low confidence properly reflects an openly disclosed, genuinely contested crux -- whether 5:26-30 belongs with the preceding hoy-and-refrain unit or bridges forward into the 9:7-10:4 poem -- and its K/Q disclosure at 5:29 correctly leaves the note's content unsliced.
items.evidence: The fresh summoned-nations imagery at “וְנָֽשָׂא נֵ֤ס לַגּוֹיִם֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וְשָׁ֥רַק ל֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא” (oshb:Isa.5.26, byte tier) is unattested in the preceding hoy unit's own vocabulary, supporting a content-level front seam, while the row candidly discloses the live rival that the stretched-hand refrain at 5:25 opens rather than closes a longer bridging poem reaching oshb:Isa.9.11 = web:Isa.9.12, oshb:Isa.9.16 = web:Isa.9.17, oshb:Isa.9.20 = web:Isa.9.21, and web:Isa.10.4. No chapter-boundary argument is used as the rear-seam driver, consistent with the rule that chapter divisions never cut.
